sentences.en: Although the circumstances are difficult, we will endeavour to overcome them.
sentences.zh: 尽管情况困难，我们也会尽力克服它们。

sentences.en: If you endeavour, fate will favour you.
sentences.zh: 如果你努力尝试，命运会对你有利。

sentences.en: We will endeavour to finish the job by the end of the week.
sentences.zh: 我们将尽力在本周结束前完成这项工作。

senses.zh: 竭力做到，试图或力图（做某事）
